# Drayker DAF

> DAF is an autonomous federation of autonomous units and a basic and primitive form of PAP, implemented now on GitHub (Phase 0): its rules, instruments and public record exist. No unit has been recorded and no assembly has been held yet. It provides a place to test federative rules in public.

## Current state

- Phase 0 is implemented on public GitHub issues, pull requests, files and history.
- Under the published DAF-000 and DAF-001 rules, delivered functions create non-transferable points and voting weight. No unit has been recorded, no points have been issued and no assembly has been held yet.
- No blockchain, token, treasury custody, anonymous participation or automated evaluation is running here.
- The public repository is the ledger; decisions must be recomputable from its history.
- Instruments in tools/ (DAF-002, a draft) check the record, regenerate the ledger, draft assembly reports, compute the arithmetic of a vote for the person who writes the report, and export a hash-linked event log. They do not judge, merge or decide.
- The repository's issues can also be read on the General Forum: https://forum.drayker.org/
